_doc: Per-file occurrence-count ratchet for direct attribute assignments to project.design_doc, project.directions, and project.vision. Read by TestDesignDocLockInvariant, TestDirectionsLockInvariant, and TestVisionLockInvariant in test_invariants.py. Counts are derived from AST-based scanning (ast.Assign / ast.AugAssign nodes), so docstrings, comments, and string literals are excluded. Counts should only decrease over time as write sites are migrated to canonical helpers (with_design_doc_locked / with_directions_locked / with_vision_locked in task_locking.py). Never increase a count — that widens the tripwire hole. When a site is migrated to the canonical helper, lower the count by 1. Remove the entry when the count reaches 0.
